request.initial_prompt: The contest between the bank and its opponents is only an incident in the great struggle which is going on in America between the provinces and the central power; between the spirit of democratic independence and the spirit of gradation and subordination. I do not mean that the enemies of the bank are identically the same individuals who, on other points, attack the Federal Government; but I assert that the attacks directed against the bank of the United States originate in the same propensities which militate against the Federal Government; and that the very numerous opponents of the former afford a deplorable symptom of the decreasing support of the latter.
request.hotwords: America, I, Federal, Government, United, States

raw_segments.text: The contest between the bank and its opponents is only an incident in the great struggle which
is going on in America between the provinces and the central power, between the spirit of
democratic independence and the spirit of gradation and subordination.
I do not mean that the enemies of the bank are identically the same individuals who,
on other points, attack the Federal Government, but I assert that the attacks directed against
the bank of the United States originate in the same propensities which militate against
the Federal Government, and that the very numerous opponents of the former afford a
deplorable symptom of the decreasing support of the latter.
